arms.primary_c2_norm: choose argmax ||c2|| from each orientation's first two nested companion bases; apply that orientation's full 17-basis correction
arms.comparator_p2_norm: choose argmax ||p2|| from each orientation's two-basis paired probe; apply that orientation's full 17-basis correction
arms.safe_full_baseline: use primary_c2_norm correction only when p1_p2_cos >= 0.90, nested_rel <= 0.70, and cos(c2,c17) >= 0.30; otherwise propagate the missing 17 primary bases and return the full 129-basis baseline
